properties.description: Pins both definitions from dec:a-rule-computes-the-condition-its-message-names from both sides: a contradiction clears only under an ACCEPTED Decision governing BOTH endpoints (proposed resolves nothing, one side is not a ruling, the CONTRADICTS edge survives, the clearance is counted under suppressed_by_resolution); an anticipation clears only when its target arrived on its own terms or EVOLVES_INTO recorded work (an accepted Requirement is a need agreed, not met; a planned Capability is not built; a faced choice nobody made still fires).
